description: Audit given Rust items or files (a crate or Cargo workspace — e.g. a command-line tool's `src/lib.rs` modules, a library) for complete rustdoc on every public item — crate/module `//!` docs, a one-sentence summary line, and the conventional `# Errors` (functions returning `Result`), `# Panics` (functions that can panic), `# Safety` (`unsafe fn`/traits) and `# Examples` (runnable doctests where they add value) sections, with intra-doc links (``[`Type::method`]``) instead of bare names — generate any missing or incomplete docs grounded in the actual code and current changes, then verify the result: the doc lints scoped to the files (`missing_docs`, `clippy::missing_errors_doc`, `clippy::missing_panics_doc`, `clippy::missing_safety_doc`, `clippy::doc_markdown`, run through `cargo clippy --message-format=json` even when the project's `[lints]` table doesn't enable them), `cargo doc --workspace --no-deps` with `RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings"` (broken intra-doc links, `rustdoc::missing_crate_level_docs`, bare URLs, invalid code-block attributes), and `cargo test --doc` so every new example compiles and passes. Knows that doctests only run for library targets — doc examples in a bin-only crate's `main.rs` are never compiled — and that this catalog's CLI scaffold keeps the logic in `lib.rs` for that reason. Invoke as `/iru-rust-rustdoc <items-or-files>` (comma-separated item paths such as `crate::output::Envelope`, `commands::greet::run`, `<member_crate>::config`, or files/globs such as `src/output.rs,src/commands/*.rs`), or `/iru-rust-rustdoc` with no argument to scope to the `.rs` files touched by uncommitted changes plus commits on the current branch not yet on the base branch. Use whenever the user (or `iru-rust-code-one-task-group` via `iru-gate-runner`) wants rustdoc completeness checked and filled in for specific Rust code, instead of waiting for a `missing_docs` warning or a broken link to fail CI.
